title: Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari (Theme 12: Magonjwa ambukizi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans hotuba before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Chanjo Dhidi ya Surua".

listen_for: moja kwa moja na hoja ya kwanza

misconceptions.repair: Hotuba huzungumza na hadhira moja kwa moja.
Funga hotuba kwa muhtasari na shukrani.
Hotuba ya kupasha habari hutoa ukweli muhimu.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika hotuba kuhusu "Chanjo Dhidi ya Surua"?
Hotuba ina sehemu zipi?
checks.answer: itifaki, utangulizi, kiini, hitimisho na shukrani
